# report/tools/index_extractions.py (status column of data_release/index_extractions.tsv), and checked by
# report/tools/check_documents.py. Status codes: primary = Primary result; secondary = Secondary result
# proposed for approval; validation = Validation-only product; notreported = Not reported.
# observables: release keys (curves_<family>_<CFG>_<key>.tsv); "total" = one-bin total; "-" = none released.
# FHC/RHC/COMB: Y = extracted and reported under this status in that configuration, N = not.
# prerequisites: identifiers of shared/prerequisites.tex that block this product ("-" = none).
